title: Desk Note: Line Kept for an Open Property Charge Repayment Record on a HECM
content:
**Rule.** Added to the amounts kept for the draw ceiling of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM): Cedarline keeps in the line what the loan's open property charge repayment record — a Property Charge Advance Repayment record on the loan — still needs, a loan holding at most one open record. The record's status, arrearage balance and monthly installment decide the arrangement reserve:

| Open repayment record on the loan | Arrangement reserve |
|---|---|
| status notice period, pending signature or defaulted, with an arrearage balance above 0.00 | the record's whole arrearage balance |
| status active, with an arrearage balance above 0.00 and a monthly installment above 0.00 | 12 monthly installments, rounded half up to the cent, or the arrearage balance when that is smaller |
| any other case (no open record, an arrearage balance of 0.00, an active record with a monthly installment of 0.00, any other status) | 0.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical records).**

- Pending signature, arrearage balance 1800.00: the reserve is 1800.00.
- Active, arrearage balance 4000.00, monthly installment 250.00: 12 installments are 3000.00, smaller than 4000.00, so the reserve is 3000.00.
- Active, arrearage balance 2000.00, monthly installment 250.00: 3000.00 is larger than 2000.00, so the reserve is 2000.00.
- Active, arrearage balance 0.00: the reserve is 0.00.
- Defaulted, arrearage balance 0.00: the reserve is 0.00.
